terms.title: Quote terms and conditions
terms.intro: Before you send your request with the quote attached, please read these terms.

sections.title: 1. What the quote is
sections.text: The amount shown by the quote builder is a ballpark estimate calculated automatically from the options you picked. It is not a binding offer or a contract: the final price is confirmed in writing after we go over the project scope together.

sections.title: 2. Scope
sections.text: The quote only covers the selected project type and features. Changes, features or content added later are quoted separately.

sections.title: 3. Currency
sections.text: Prices are calculated in Colombian pesos (COP). The US dollar (USD) amount is approximate, at a reference rate, and may vary with the exchange rate.

sections.title: 4. Timelines and rush delivery
sections.text: Delivery times are estimates and depend on the client providing the needed copy, images, access and approvals on time. Rush delivery carries a 25% surcharge.

sections.title: 5. Payment and validity
sections.text: Payment terms are agreed in the formal proposal. That proposal is valid for 30 days from the day it is sent.

sections.title: 6. Ownership
sections.text: The project's code and files are handed over to the client once the full payment has been made.

sections.title: 7. Personal data
sections.text: The details you send (name, email, phone and message) are only used to answer your request and prepare the proposal, in line with Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012. They are never shared with third parties, and you can ask for them to be deleted by writing to josesalopaso@gmail.com.

sections.title: 8. No commitment
sections.text: Sending this request does not oblige either party to sign a contract.

terms.accept: I have read and accept the terms and conditions
terms.required: To send the quote you need to accept the terms and conditions.
